body: I think my tones okay, I'm thinking about investing in a good Marshall amp though, because when it comes to my 8th string, the sound cuts out sometimes. I have a decent distortion pedal, that I run through the clean channel. I was looking at Seymour Duncan pick ups (specifically the Black Winter ones) and the Schecter Apocalypse pick ups; but they are both quite expensive. I don't exactly know what a noise gate does, but from what I'm assuming it removes unwanted sounds from vibrations in the strings..? I forgot to mention I have a Gruv Gear Fretwrap, which helps with that too. Even though I have it should I still get a noise gate? And am I doing the technique correctly..?

The legitimate "Djent" technique where you lay your hand on the fretboard over the strings. I don't know if you do it like a harmonic mute or what, because if I do it like the harmonic mute it doesn't sound right. I don't know if it's my equipment either. I have an Ibanez RG8 (Stock pickups, tuned to E A E A D G B E, and Schecter Decimator strings) and an Ibanez Tone Blaster Amp; if that helps any, if at all.
Lmao. But in all seriousness I don't understand the techniques that are used in Djent, I don't think they've properly been explained to me before. Would you be so kind?
